اضطبنتا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَبَنَتَا (iḍṭabanatā) /idˤ.tˤa.ba.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اُضْطُبِنَتَا (uḍṭubinatā) /udˤ.tˤu.bi.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
